name.description:
name of the field that is consider as a quasi identifier
the name could be a path to the field

valueType.description:
ValueType of the quasi identifier field
If unspecified, it will be guessed based on the input

title:
Quasi-identifiers are pieces of information that are not of themselves unique identifiers, but are sufficiently well
correlated with an entity that they can be combined with other quasi-identifiers to create a unique identifier.
This type is used for Data anonymization algorithm in Anonymizer type.
name: QuasiId
